name: @finapp/m15a-matching
description: M15a — the PURE, deterministic, explainable bank-reconciliation matching engine (no I/O, no tables). Scores statement lines against ledger entries by configurable rule kinds (exact reference/amount, date window, similarity, composite), assigns confidence bands + colour status, and classifies match types (1:1, 1:many, many:1, split, grouped). Money is integer minor units — never float. Consumed by m15-recon.
